title: Grateful Dead Live at Eagles Auditorium on 1968-01-27
lineage: Dat (Sony R500) -> Sound Devices 744T -> Adobe Audition v1.5 -> Samplitude Professional v10.2 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Clear soundboard recording that captures an epic, snappy‑drummed Spanish Jam with a prominent Phil mix.
ai_review.review: The tape offers a clean, well‑preserved soundboard source – albeit with a slightly different balance (Phil pushed forward and a reversed stereo image compared to other Seattle tapes). Musically the highlight is the over‑18‑minute Spanish Jam, praised for its flamenco interplay and relentless energy, making it one of the tour’s most memorable moments.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews are overwhelmingly positive about the performance (especially the Spanish Jam) and note a clear, decent‑quality soundboard source; minor mix quirks keep confidence at medium.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clearer tape with less wear than comparable sources; Phil is higher in the mix and stereo image appears reversed relative to other Seattle shows, but overall clarity and balance are solid.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The Spanish Jam closes the show, stretched out over 18 minutes; reviewers note its extended, almost cinematic development rather than any pacing issues.

band_member_comments.Phil: Noted to be a bit higher in the mix on this tape.
band_member_comments.Drums: Snappy drumming highlighted as a key element of the Spanish Jam.
